newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU 97/98 grain output seen at 192-199 mln T - AGPM.
newsitem.headline: EU 97/98 grain output seen at 192-199 mln T - AGPM.

text.p: European Union grain output for 1997/98 may decline to between 192 and 199 million tonnes from 203.1 million tonnes in the previous season, the French maize growers association AGPM said in its May report.

The estimate is below the prediction made last week by the European Commission's agriculture directorate general of grain output of 201.2 million tonnes for 1997/98 against 200.7 million tonnes in 1996/97.

In its routine note to operators, the AGPM said its prediction was based on estimates drawn up by the Coceral and Copa grain industry lobbies which showed a lower than expected rise in EU sowings for the 1997 harvest.
The AGPM forecast also takes into account an expected drop in EU grain yields due to a three-month dry spell.
But AGPM said its prediction must be taken with caution as it was based on average trends for yields.
"Last year's exceptional yield of 5.55 tonnes per hectare is unlikely to be repeated," AGPM said, adding dry weather had already led to grain yield losses.

"Assuming the last five-year average of 5.1 tonnes per hectare, grain production in the Community would be 192 million tonnes. Based on the trend for average yield over the last 20 years (5.3 tonnes per hectare), it would reach 199 million tonnes," it said.
AGPM said recent estimates from Coceral and Copa suggested the EU grain area for the 1997 harvest would not rise by more than 700,000 hectares or two percent over 1996.
This was below expectations generated by a grain set-aside rate of five percent for 1997, AGPM said.
On April 18 Coceral predicted the grain area might rise by 2.2 percent to 37.088 million hectares in 1997 from 36.298 million in 1996.

It predicted the soft wheat area at 14.032 million hectares, up two percent over 1996, the barley area at 11.656 million hectares, up 2.8 percent, and the maize area barely changed at 4.113 million hectares.
Copa sees the EU grain area rising to 37.649 million hectares in 1997 from 36.912 million in 1996.

It puts the soft wheat area at 14.064 million hectares against 13.782 million, the barley area at 11.785 million hectares against 11.387 million, and the maize area at 4.162 million hectares against 4.188 million.
